03 / Event management

Rave with BBC · 29 December 2023

End-to-end event coordination

At Rave with BBC, held at FCB Base in Okitipupa, Ondo State, I managed the event process myself, from planning through execution.

  • Coordinated artists and communications
  • Negotiated with venues
  • Managed event-budget planning
  • Handled ticket-sales planning
  • Oversaw event planning and execution
  • Coordinated event promotion materials and BBC branding

The flyer lists a multi-artist lineup including OLW Maro, Cardee, Hypeman System, Folahanmi, Komputa, Ovumix, Scholardoo and Sam Sitz.

Additional event experience

BBC also hosted listening-party experiences for Folahanmi’s “Do You Really Care” mixtape in Lagos and Akure, Ondo State.
